newsitem.title: USA: Res-Care names Pamela Spaniac as CFO.
newsitem.headline: Res-Care names Pamela Spaniac as CFO.

text.p: Res-Care Inc said on Monday it named Pamela Spaniac to the position of executive vice president of finance and administration and she will assume the role of chief financial officer, effective August 15.
Spaniac previously served as vice president and controller of Coram Healthcare Corp, the company said.
The name of Spaniac's predecessor was not immediately available.
Res-Care's previous chief financial officer was Doug Webb, who left the company in November 1996, a company spokeswoman said.
